publicationColumns.generation_id: STRING; immutable opaque ASCII generation, 1..128 chars
publicationColumns.row_count: INT64 0..2; store_orders/online_orders rows for this partition
publicationColumns.row_hashes: ARRAY<STRING>; exact unique lowercase SHA-256 hashes of those rows; [] for zero rows
publicationColumns.cdc_watermark: TIMESTAMP; common source transaction-consistent CDC point, including late offline receipt acceptance/imports
publicationColumns.source_position: STRING; common canonical source commit/GTID position matching [A-Za-z0-9:._,-]{1,4096}
publicationColumns.publication_state: STRING literal COMPLETE, after all rollups/auxiliary values are visible

rollupColumns.types: Existing source metrics are finite numeric values. order_count and pending_offline_orders are nonnegative safe integers; pending count cannot exceed store order count and is zero for online_orders. Banking, footfall and target are nullable numeric values. order_date is DATE. order_source is store_orders or online_orders.

hashExpression: Import dailyWarehouseRowHashExpression from backend/src/modules/daily-report-warehouse.ts; compute in BigQuery with its exact ordered CAST/STRUCT/TO_JSON_STRING/SHA256/TO_HEX expression. The reader computes row_hash itself, not from a stored unverified hash column.
moneyPolicy: Preserve mutable source HP revenue/quantity/status. CASE-exclude exact sealed imported orders only from cash/order count, retain original cash in source online residual, then add each immutable receipt payable/count once on signed business_date. Keep accepted/conflicted/importing money. pending_offline_orders counts receipts whose status is not imported. Never synthesize HP revenue or quantities from payable cash.
publicationRules: Publish a new immutable generation; never edit a completed generation.
Publish exactly one manifest row for every requested store/date, including stores/dates with zero sales and zero receipts.
All selected rows/manifests/banking/footfall/target must come from one consistent source CDC position and generation.
Late receipts, import finalization, source returns and banking changes must reach both rollups and manifests before COMPLETE.
Readers verify coverage, counts, identities, hashes, pinned contracts, timezone and clock freshness even when the result is empty.
No MySQL history fallback; missing or stale contracts/publications fail closed. Actual mappings, publisher ACLs, ingestion lag and native warehouse parity must be verified before release.
